en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 9.3.
Hetuduka, Vipākattikādi (The Dyad on Roots, the Triad beginning with Resultant, etc.)
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a result... [etc. (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor of a nature to produce a result... [etc. (In all cases, nine. In the case of results, one.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause, nor a result, nor of a nature to produce a result... [etc. (In all cases, nine.)
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor acquired through clinging and subject to clinging … (nine in all).
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor not acquired through clinging but subject to clinging … (nine in all).
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor not acquired through clinging and not subject to clinging … (nine in all).
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause (*nahetu*) nor afflicted (*na-saṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*) … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor non-afflicted-non-afflicted (*na-asaṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*) … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor non-afflicted-non-afflicted (*na-asaṅkiliṭṭha-asaṅkilesika*) … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.)
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by both initial and sustained application of mind … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor without initial application but with sustained application only … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor without both initial and sustained application of mind … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by pleasure … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by happiness … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by equanimity … (nine in all).

Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … [all nine; there is no resultant].
Dependent on a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned by vision … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned by cultivation … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … (nine in all; there is no resultant).
